title: README presents ~/Devel/opt/devbin as the machine install a user seeds projects from; a user installs from brew, and dev and opt are the maintainer's (hv's dev, opt, brew directive)
body:
Found by vc on 2026-10-24, sizing devbin's move to a public repository (ST0010), against hv's directive of the same day: anything released through Homebrew follows dev, opt, brew as dev, stage, prod, and a user installs from brew.

README.md presents `~/Devel/opt/devbin` as "the machine install" a user seeds projects from: line 72 (`~/Devel/opt/devbin/bin/devbin install --into ~/some/new/project`, called "Preferred"), line 75 (`export DEVBIN_SOURCE=~/Devel/opt/devbin`) and line 220 (the layout table's "the install" row). devbin's runtime has had no default install location since 2026-09-07 (docs/configuration.md, "There is no default"); `~/Devel/opt/devbin` is the maintainer's own declared `install.prefix` (bin/.devbin/config.yaml), the opt of a dev checkout.

Fix: the README's user route is the brew install (`brew install matthewsinclair/devbin/devbin`), and seeding a project is `devbin install --into <project>` from the brew install, as 0197 made `$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/devbin` the source fleet and upgrade read. The dev checkout and its opt publish move to a section for the maintainer of a dev checkout, named as such. Check every doc a user reads (README, docs/, lib/pages) for the same framing.

Done when: no doc a user reads presents a checkout or an opt publish as the way to install devbin; the maintainer's dev, opt, brew flow is documented once, for the maintainer; documentation.bats holds the user docs to it; for the release before devbin's public push.


## Resolution

Fixed at 4339a60e for the release before devbin's public push, on landing suite 20261024-0831 at the stack tip 6cc594fb (2442 of 2442 ok, 5 environmental skips, the errors seal empty) (cc built it in a scratch clone of main at ee348f80; vc landed it).

- The README's `## Install` opens with the user's route: `brew tap` with the ssh url, `brew install matthewsinclair/devbin/devbin`, and `devbin install --into ~/some/new/project` from the brew install. `dvb` is emitted from the brew install (`eval "$(devbin shell-init zsh)"`), so its machine-install fallback is Homebrew's opt path, and `dvb install` in a new project seeds from it. "Keeping it current" starts at `brew upgrade devbin`, and the WSL steps install devbin from brew.
- The dev checkout and its opt publish are documented once, in the README's `## For the maintainer of a dev checkout`: the dev, opt, brew tiers as dev, stage and prod, `install.prefix`, the publish verbs, the machine pointer against the brew install, `DEVBIN_SOURCE`, and the formula's publish by a release. Its paths are placeholders, never one machine's layout; the README names `~/Devel` nowhere. docs/configuration.md's `install.prefix` points at it, and docs/migration.md, lib/pages/shell-init.md and lib/pages/install.md say a user seeds from the brew install.
- `dvb`'s remedy when it finds nothing (lib/cmd/shell-init) says to install devbin with Homebrew, where it said to publish from inside devbin. It does not name the tap: the vendored set names no person.
- `tests/unit/documentation.bats` holds it: no doc a user reads names a home directory's Devel tree; the README's first block under Install installs from brew; the maintainer's section exists, names `install.prefix` and `DEVBIN_SOURCE`, and the README names neither outside it; and its heading is the only one across the user docs. `shellinit.bats`'s no-prefix arm asserts the brew remedy. Red on main (the README's opt seeding lines, configuration.md's quoted default path, the Install section's first block, and dvb's publish remedy), green at the fix under BSD and GNU tools; each arm declares what it cannot catch.
- Left as they are, out of this issue: the tap is still private and ssh (ST0010's public push decides that line); the README's documentation table names `intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE-shell.md`, which ST0010's candidate tree drops; lib/install's warning for an unplaced install lists `install.prefix` ahead of Homebrew.
